subject: WARNING: ICS WhatsApp API Performance Degraded
body:
WARNING: The ICS WhatsApp API is experiencing performance degradation.

Alert Time: {alert_time}
Current Response Time: {response_time}
Consecutive Slow Checks: {consecutive_slow_checks}
Threshold: {threshold}

SYMPTOMS:
- API responses are significantly slower than normal
- Message delivery may be delayed
- User experience may be impacted

RECOMMENDED ACTIONS:
1. Monitor API performance closely
2. Check ICS service status for any announcements
3. Prepare for potential escalation if performance worsens
4. Review application logs for any patterns

The system will continue monitoring and will send additional alerts if the situation escalates.
